about.title: About Black Girl's Dream Initiative
about.lead: A youth-led not-for-profit in Ibadan, founded by Karimot Odebode, working for quality education and for girls' place in leadership.
about.mission: To build an equitable society by empowering women and girls to be leaders and decision-makers, and reorienting boys and men.
about.vision: To be a foremost organisation that transforms education and bridges the gender gap.
about.story1: Karimot Odebode founded Black Girl's Dream Initiative in Ibadan in 2021, starting with debate and public speaking sessions for girls in public secondary schools.
about.story2: BGDI is youth-led: most of the people who run it, and every coach, are young volunteers. Its programmes now cover debate, STEM, getting out-of-school children back into class, and tracking how education money is spent.

best.d: We aim for the best outcome for every student, not the easiest one.

accountability.d: We publish what we do and measure whether it works.

leadership.d: Every girl can lead. We give her the room and the practice.

collaboration.d: We work with schools, families, government and partners.

kindness.d: We treat every child, volunteer and family with care.
